order_reason.SIDE: A location forecast of the margin. It depends on nothing else.
order_reason.TOTAL: A forecast of the sum. Combined with the side it pins both team numbers through home=(total+margin)/2 and away=(total-margin)/2, so the side must be fixed first.
order_reason.MONEYLINE: A tail probability of the margin distribution. It needs the centre from the side and the scale, which is set by the scoring environment the total forecasts.

_meta.identity: implied_home_points - implied_away_points == fair_side and implied_home_points + implied_away_points == fair_total, checked on every row.
_meta.tie_handling: fair_p_tie is published separately. The fair moneyline price is computed on the tie-excluded conditional probabilities p_home/(p_home+p_away) and p_away/(p_home+p_away), which is how a two-way market is quoted. The unconditional probabilities are on the row.

leak_probe.verdict: The probe recovers the outcome exactly when the outcome is allowed in, so the harness does detect leakage. The published model does not contain it: its regressors are ratings and scoring rates computed before kickoff.
